first_public_date_evidence: R. Durrett and J. E. Steif (1991), scholarly record specifying published October 1, 1991, DOI 10.1007/BF01259549. Earlier founding publication dated only May 1978 and not assigned a spurious day.
scientific_integrity: Direct exhaustive checking and rational arithmetic reproduced the finite controls; general theorem proved separately using a dependence graph and published bounds. The 1978 founding paper is dated to May only, whereas 1991-10-01 is the earliest day-resolved public GHM source cited here; no day is invented for 1978.
scientific_limitations: Only initial primitive period-three behavior is counted; no sharp relative asymptotic for the extremely small wave probability, no claim for eventual basins. All-dimensional proof invokes published Chen–Stein theorem; exhaustive finite checks limited to dimensions 1–3. Absolute historical priority not independently established.
title: Almost-independent phase defects and vanishing immediate excitation waves on Boolean cubes
